content: Docker Desktop + WSL2 + Oracle containers: WSL2's VM (vmmem) dynamically grows memory and does not release it until 'wsl --shutdown' -- Oracle's own memory footprint compounds this, and unbounded vmmem growth has been observed consuming all host RAM and spilling into pagefile, tanking host performance; mitigate with an explicit memory= (and processors=) cap in %UserProfile%\.wslconfig and a restart via 'wsl --shutdown'. Windows 11 24H2's WSL 'mirrored' networking mode (enabled by default) turns on IPv6 preference inside WSL/containers and has caused Oracle-container connection timeouts when clients/apps still assume IPv4 -- symptom is intermittent hangs connecting to the DB listener from the WSL host or other containers; verify networkingMode and IPv4 reachability explicitly if this happens.
